answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the shale of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the zenith until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the willow of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
